recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant 1970s-style composition featuring a central circular portal containing a group of performers, set against a background of horizontal stripes and a large, multi-colored concentric arch that mimics a stylized rainbow or sunburst.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular frame containing the primary photographic subject
Horizontal stripes intersecting the central circle
Concentric rainbow bands framing the top half of the subject
High-contrast lighting on subjects against a dark interior background
coreInvariants: Primary color palette of cyan, yellow, and red
Heavy black base at the bottom of the composition
Stylized white cloud shapes on the right horizon line

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four performers positioned in the lower two-thirds of a central circular frame, scaled to show upper bodies and microphones.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large circular frame and the thick red/blue/white concentric arch.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the horizontal stripes from left to right, then curve upward along the rainbow arch to the top-aligned text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black area at the bottom and within the circular frame behind the performers.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan blue used for the sky background and outer ring.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black used for the bottom third and the interior of the circle.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red and yellow used for horizontal stripes and the rainbow arch.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with flat, unshaded color blocks contrasting against a realistic, high-contrast photograph.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy, blocky glyphs with uniform stroke width
Inline white detailing or negative space cuts within the letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'A' lacks a crossbar or uses a very low one
The letter 'E' has three equal-length horizontal bars with no vertical stem extension
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy display face for all primary text to maintain graphic impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, circular nature of the glyphs.
Captures the 70s display vibe and blocky proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 1970s graphic background with a cyan top half and black bottom half. In the center, place a large circle. Inside the circle, show four soul singers in high-contrast lighting against a black background. Surround the top of the circle with a thick concentric arch of red, blue, and white. Add horizontal stripes of yellow and cyan across the middle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of heavy, white, geometric display text at the very top, centered. The letters should be blocky and uppercase with a retro-futurist feel.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered at the top?
Are the horizontal stripes present and intersecting the circle?
Is the bottom third of the image solid black?
Does the rainbow arch follow the curve of the central circle?

adjustableVariables: Number of performers in the circle
Color sequence of the rainbow arch
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is white and blocky.
Check that the circular frame is perfectly centered horizontally.
Verify the color palette is limited to the specified retro tones.
Confirm the bottom area is a clean black field.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central circular portal + concentric rainbow arch + horizontal banding + top-aligned geometric display type.
